title: Simple Habits for Clog-Free Drains
description: Preventing blocked drains is much easier than dealing with a sudden backup. Start by placing mesh strainers over kitchen and bathroom sinks to catch hair, food scraps, and soap scum before they enter your pipes. Never pour cooking fats, oils, or grease down the drain, as they solidify inside the plumbing and trap other debris. In the bathroom, flush only toilet paper—even products labeled flushable can cause severe blockages over time. Running hot water down the kitchen sink after washing dishes helps clear residual grease. If you notice slow drainage or foul odors, schedule a professional plumbing inspection to clear minor buildup before it becomes a major problem.
